in_arabic.name: جهدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'ج-ه-د' which means 'to hide' or 'conceal'. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl, suggesting protection, secrecy, and the idea of something precious being kept hidden.

in_urdu.name: جاہدہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'ج-ه-د' which means 'to hide' or 'conceal'. In Urdu, it is written as 'جاہدہ' and translates to 'struggler' or 'fighter'. This name is perfect for a baby girl who is destined to overcome challenges and fight for her dreams.

in_hindi.name: जहूदा
in_hindi.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'ج-ه-د' which means 'to hide' or 'conceal'. In Hindi, it is written as 'जहूदा' and translates to 'hider' or 'concealer'. This name is perfect for a baby girl who will grow up to protect and shield those she loves.

in_pashto.name: ژهوده
in_pashto.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'ج-ه-د' which means 'to hide' or 'conceal'. In Pashto, it is written as 'ژهوده' and translates to 'concealer' or 'hider'. This name is perfect for a baby girl who will grow up to keep secrets and protect the ones she loves.
